lines.zh: 我一步一步爬上湿树干。
lines.en: I climb the wet trunk, step by step.

lines.zh: 我跳一下，能跨两片叶子。
lines.en: One hop crosses two leaves.
My toe pads grip the bark.
I shuffle along a leaf.
The rain just stopped. The bark is slick.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶跳到另一片。
lines.en: I hop from leaf to leaf.
I climb down the branch.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，叶子不弯。
lines.en: Light steps. The leaf does not bend.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾有吸盘，爬得稳。
lines.en: Suction pads on my toes keep me steady.
I pause in the fork of the tree.
I hop back where I started.
The damp makes my skin shine.
I creep half a block up the trunk.
I slip between the vines.
I squat in the leaf's cup, still.
Squatting on a leaf, blinking slowly.
Drops fall on my back.
I listen to the insects.
Enough water in this leaf for me.

lines.zh: 我鼓着喉咙，蹲在叶子上。
lines.en: Throat puffed, I squat on a leaf.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很大，闭不太上。
lines.en: My eyes are big and hardly close.

lines.zh: 湿气让我的皮肤很舒服。
lines.en: The damp suits my skin.
I wait for a bug to come near.

lines.zh: 树干上除了我，没有别人。
lines.en: Nothing on this trunk but me.
Curled into a tiny ball, like a leaf.
I count the drops on the leaf.
Up here is safer than the ground.
Something passes below.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，跟叶子一样。
lines.en: Still, I look like a leaf.
Light rain again.
I wipe my eyes with a foreleg.

lines.zh: 我听见水从叶尖滴下去。
lines.en: Water drips from the leaf's tip.
Look up. There I am.

lines.zh: 四只脚趾紧紧吸住树皮。
lines.en: Four toe pads cling to the bark.
My color matches the leaves.
Keep your hand from under the leaf.
I jump farther than you think.
I have drunk from this tree.
Too dry down there. I stay up.
Your scent is strong.

lines.zh: 我在看你，你未必看得见我。
lines.en: I see you. You may not see me.
Do not poke the leaves with that stick.
This wood is damp. I like it.
I hop off. You are still standing.
A cut in my skin.
I leap away and stop far off.
A little slime seeps out.
I curl up on the leaf.

lines.zh: 雨林里的蛙，指头有吸盘。
lines.en: Tree frog pads stick to anything.
I do not call. It would draw more.
I move to the underside.
One leg is stiff.
I rest on the branch.

lines.zh: 湿皮破了一点，还跳得动。
lines.en: The wet skin split, I can still hop.
A bug? I eat those.
That bug is held too high.
Not fruit. Too sweet.
Put it on a leaf and I will come.
Too small. Not a mouthful.
I do not eat anything waterlogged.
Do not crush it. Then I will not come.
The bug flees when your hand moves.
That would last me a day.
Set it down. One step back is enough.
You touched the leaf; I jumped.
I hop right off your hand.
My skin is wet and slick.
You shake, I grip.
I land on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 跳开的时候，我撞了另一片叶。
lines.en: I bumped another leaf jumping.
Do not squeeze. I will leap.
Your finger is thicker than my leg.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，又跳回树上。
lines.en: I flip over and hop back up.
So light you felt nothing.

lines.zh: 雨后的池塘，我们聚到一起。
lines.en: After rain, we gather at the pools.
My call carries far.
Eggs go in the water's edge.
Ask that and I stop calling.

lines.zh: 我只在潮湿的地方活动。
lines.en: I only move where it is damp.
Tree matters are the tree's business.
I know each voice in the chorus.
Do not disturb. This matters.
The water on the ground is enough.
Stand back and I keep calling.
I drink the drop in the leaf.

lines.zh: 那只虫子，我用舌头卷走。
lines.en: My tongue takes the bug.
What you dropped landed on a leaf.
I flick it off with a forefoot.
Too heavy to carry.
Tree frog toes stick to the leaf.

lines.zh: 叶子上的水珠，我一颗颗喝。
lines.en: I drink the drops one by one.
My mouth is too small to grip it.
You take it. I am not coming down.
I leave it until I am hungry.
A bug is flying in.
Belly to the bark, I creep down.
My hind legs coil, gathering power.
My eyes fix on your fingertip.
The distance comes out exact.
A leaf moved, and it was not wind.
The leaf moved. Not wind.
I have the landing spot.
The damp keeps me quiet.
Now I jump.
I creep along the leaf.
I pause, then move half an inch.
My color hides me well.
I wait for you to stop moving.
My throat sac pulses and quivers.
Two inches. Enough.
Hear the leaf rustle?
I go over and come behind you.
A drop rolls off by my feet.
One beat more, then I leap.
I bump your finger.
My slime rubs onto you.
I land on the back of your hand.
I kick off and leap away.
My toe pads stick to the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 舌头弹出去，黏住你的指。
lines.en: My tongue flicks out and sticks to your finger.
You shake your hand; I am on a leaf.
The slime makes me hard to hold.
My call startled you.
I land back on the tree as if nothing.
A spot of green on the leaf.
The rain stopped. I came out.

lines.zh: 从湿树皮里探出绿脑袋。
lines.en: A green head pokes from wet bark.
I take up the water in the leaf's cup.
A very short call.
A small shape on the trunk.

lines.zh: 湿气重的时候，我醒过来。
lines.en: I wake when the air is damp.
The leaf turns, and there I am.
Damp wood. Just right.

lines.zh: 我叫了两声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: Two calls. A greeting.
The leaf moved. It was me.
I settle in the fork.
Where there is water, there am I.
I look down from the treetop.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的皮肤就干了。
lines.en: Fire dries my skin.
My toes have suction pads.
Too deep. No footing.
The blast knocks me off the tree.
An arrow grazes my back.
Magic freezes my legs.

lines.zh: 没有虫子，我越来越没力。
lines.en: No bugs and my strength drains.
Thunder makes me leap clear.
No ground below the tree.
